faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes G500 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. Pre-2018 W463 models used the M113 and later the M273 naturally aspirated V8s. From 2018 onwards, the W463a generation switched to the M176 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes G500 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500, for all engine codes. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my G500?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M113, M273, or M176 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M113 G500 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M113 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M273 G500 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M273 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild M176 G500 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components and bearings as standard on every M176 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used G500 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my G500 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an G500 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most G500 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
